misc: Famous for being an ambassador for the AimPoint method for putting.
biography: Timo, representing Keimola Golf, is poised to make his ninth appearance in the esteemed Hector Trophée, a testament to his enduring commitment and skill within this premier pairs competition. His consistent presence since his debut has cemented his status as a familiar and respected figure on the tournament circuit.

Throughout his eight prior participations, Timo has distinguished himself as a profoundly effective team player. He has been a pivotal force in securing the coveted Hector Trophée for his pair on three separate occasions, showcasing an exceptional ability to synchronize with his partners and navigate the intricate challenges of the format. While individual glory, in the form of the Victor Trophy, has yet to be captured, his contributions to his respective teams have been undeniably instrumental.

Timo's approach to golf is characterized by a meticulous attention to detail and a strategic mind, particularly evident in his putting. He is widely recognized as an ambassador for the AimPoint method, a technique he champions with an unwavering conviction, demonstrating his dedication to mastering every facet of the game. This precise, analytical mindset is a hallmark of his play, often providing a crucial advantage on the greens.

As he prepares for the Hector Trophée 2026, the golfing community watches with keen interest to see if Timo's unparalleled team prowess and precision will once again lead his pairing to victory, or if this could be the year he adds the elusive individual Victor Trophy to his impressive collection of team accolades.
